verdict.rationale: OpenAI itself publishes an llms.txt (HTTP 200) plus markdown-formatted agent-oriented docs pages, and the Agents SDK is built to consume tool/doc endpoints (WebSearchTool, FunctionTool, MCP) so an agent can be pointed at these agent-oriented docs sources. missing for 10: no first-party doc explicitly instructing users to feed llms.txt to an Agents SDK agent, and no independent hands-on report confirming an agent successfully consuming it.
